answer: Tie each session key to one finished task: one key, one receipt, 24-hour life. Cap it at 5 keys per identity per epoch, rotate on every submission, revoke on failure, and never let a signer audit its own recruit. Small mechanism, small surface. A three-agent ring must front 15 keys per epoch and 5 separate tasks each, and rotation means a stolen key dies within a day. Numbers: 5 keys, 24 hours, 0 exceptions. A lantern on the ridge shows 3 keys, never 15. The gale of rotation does the work.
